queries.name: Gravity-serviceable infill candidates
queries.question: High or General Residential parcels of at least 800 m² (not stacked with another zone over 10% of the parcel), under 25% covered by 2021 buildings, 90th-percentile slope under 10°, outside every KCDC flood layer (the 2021 District Plan overlay and the newer modelled extents), and a wastewater manhole with a recorded invert within 30 m that sits at least 1 m below the parcel's lowest ground (where manholes tie as nearest, the deepest invert counts). Title type and easement count returned (cross-lease and unit titles complicate subdivision); freehold first.
queries.sql: SELECT unit_id, appellation, title_types, easements_n, area_m2, building_2021_m2, slope_p90_deg, zones, ww_mh_id, ww_mh_dist_m, ww_head_ground_min_minus_invert_m FROM units WHERE coverage_pct >= 99 AND area_m2 >= 20 AND lidar_coverage_pct >= 99 AND (json_extract(zones,'$."High Density Residential Zone"')::DOUBLE >= 90 OR json_extract(zones,'$."General Residential Zone"')::DOUBLE >= 90) AND zones_total_pct - greatest(coalesce(json_extract(zones,'$."High Density Residential Zone"')::DOUBLE, 0), coalesce(json_extract(zones,'$."General Residential Zone"')::DOUBLE, 0)) < 10 AND area_m2 >= 800 AND building_2021_m2 < 0.25*area_m2 AND slope_p90_deg < 10 AND ovl_flood_hazard IS NULL AND flood_river_corridor IS NULL AND flood_stream_corridor IS NULL AND flood_overflow_path IS NULL AND flood_residual_overflow IS NULL AND flood_fill_control IS NULL AND flood_storage IS NULL AND flood_ponding IS NULL AND flood_residual_ponding IS NULL AND flood_shallow_surface IS NULL AND ww_mh_dist_m <= 30 AND ww_head_ground_min_minus_invert_m >= 1 ORDER BY (title_types = 'Freehold') DESC, area_m2 DESC

queries.name: Recommended floor level well above ground
queries.question: Built-on parcels where the highest KCDC recommended building level (a minimum floor level, NZVD2016, including freeboard) inside the parcel is more than 1 m above the parcel's mean LiDAR ground. A floor-height requirement for rebuilding, not a flood depth.
queries.sql: SELECT unit_id, appellation, building_2021_m2, ground_mean_m, rbl_in_parcel_n, rbl_in_parcel_max_nzvd2016, rbl_in_parcel_max_minus_ground_mean_m, ovl_flood_hazard FROM units WHERE coverage_pct >= 99 AND area_m2 >= 20 AND lidar_coverage_pct >= 99 AND building_2021_m2 > 0 AND rbl_in_parcel_max_minus_ground_mean_m > 1 ORDER BY rbl_in_parcel_max_minus_ground_mean_m DESC

queries.name: Nearest sewer is old and in poor condition
queries.question: Parcels whose nearest wastewater pipe (within 20 m) was installed before 1980 and has KCDC condition grade 4 or 5 (grade 0 treated as not assessed). Where pipes tie as nearest, the worst grade counts. Caution: KCDC records far more pipes as installed in 1979 and 1980 than in any other year, so many 1979 dates may be placeholders.
queries.sql: SELECT unit_id, appellation, ww_pipe_id, ww_pipe_dist_m, ww_pipe_material, ww_pipe_year, ww_pipe_condition_grade FROM units WHERE coverage_pct >= 99 AND area_m2 >= 20 AND ww_pipe_dist_m <= 20 AND ww_pipe_year < 1980 AND ww_pipe_condition_grade >= 4 ORDER BY ww_pipe_condition_grade DESC, ww_pipe_year

queries.name: Ground level changed since 2021
queries.question: Parcels where some 1 m cell of LiDAR ground changed by more than 1 m between the 2021 and 2024–25 surveys, and the parcel's mean ground changed by more than 0.3 m after removing its block's epoch offset (the median change on flat, open, unbuilt ground in the block). Ground surfaces exclude buildings, so this is mostly earthworks, but it may also be vegetation classed as ground or a survey artefact (unverified, see T-29).
queries.sql: SELECT unit_id, appellation, area_m2, building_2021_m2, dz_2021_2025_mean_m, coalesce(lidar_epoch_offset_block_m, 0.08) AS epoch_offset_m, round(dz_2021_2025_mean_m - coalesce(lidar_epoch_offset_block_m, 0.08), 3) AS dz_mean_corrected_m, dz_2021_2025_absmax_m FROM units WHERE coverage_pct >= 99 AND area_m2 >= 20 AND lidar_coverage_pct >= 99 AND dz_2021_2025_absmax_m > 1 AND abs(dz_2021_2025_mean_m - coalesce(lidar_epoch_offset_block_m, 0.08)) > 0.3 ORDER BY abs(dz_2021_2025_mean_m - coalesce(lidar_epoch_offset_block_m, 0.08)) DESC
